title: Settings
planPaneMenus: Each pane's ⋮ menu offers its own switches too.

mcp.intro: The MCP sees only the roots listed here, and everything inside them. Private nodes stay hidden even inside a root. Agentic tasks inside a root can also be written; everything else is read-only.
mcp.none: No roots yet — the MCP sees nothing.
mcp.hidden: Private — the MCP cannot see it
mcp.missing: A node that no longer exists

endpoint.heading: Endpoint
endpoint.invalidPort: A port is a whole number from 1 to 65535.
endpoint.envOverride: ARLESH_MCP_PORT is set, so the endpoint uses port {{port}} instead of this setting until it is unset.

agents.heading: Agents
agents.intro: An agent attaches with a one-time PIN, then sees only the subtree it claims. One active claim may cover any node. The arlesh-notify mod attaches for you; otherwise give the agent a PIN.
agents.pinHelp: Give this PIN to the agent (the arlesh-notify mod does it for you); it works once.

standingNote.unclaimed: It holds no claim, so it sees nothing.
standingNote.active: It reads and writes inside its claim.
standingNote.paused: Another agent may claim the subtree; it reads but writes nothing.
standingNote.shadowed: Its claim now overlaps an older active claim, so it sees nothing until that is resolved.
standingNote.unreachable: Its subtree left the MCP roots, went private or was deleted, so it sees nothing.

capacity.account_locked: At capacity: its account is locked by hand
capacity.usage_limit: At capacity: {{window}} limit used up, resets {{time}}

agents.showStatus: Show agent status in the top bar
